installation.description: The layout v5 installation the layout v4 parameters were carried to.

from.description: The source: the layout v4 installation whose parameters are deleted.

phase.description: started: kept before the first delete; completed: kept after the last one.

plan.description: The plan hash the operator confirmed.

planned.description: How many parameters the confirmed plan deletes.

deleted.description: How many parameters were deleted so far (completed) or none (started).

kept.description: How many parameters the plan keeps.

names.description: The names of the parameters to delete, below the source's roots. Names only, never a value.
